name: UCI Scientific Clinical Research Internship Program (SCRIP)
org: UC Irvine School of Medicine, Office of Research
what_you_do: Volunteer in a UC Irvine research lab under a faculty sponsor. You must line up the sponsor yourself before you apply.
who_can_apply: High school students who are 16 or older. A parent must also sign the permission form. You must find a UC Irvine faculty sponsor on your own. The program will not match you with one.
pay_detail: Unpaid. It is a volunteer, non-credit program. No fee is listed.
duration: 1 month to 12 months. It runs in fall, winter, spring and summer.
deadline_text: No closing date is posted. The Office of Research collects completed packets every quarter.
how_to_apply: Find a lab and a UC Irvine faculty sponsor. Give your sponsor and their department the packet. It has an application, a medical form, a safety form and a parent form.
notes: Without a faculty sponsor, your application is not considered. Email Alondra Garcia at alondg19@hs.uci.edu with questions. The page also lists 949-824-5388 for general Education and Admissions.
